title: FJZ80 LS swap
ai_summary: 1997 FZJ80 swap using a stock 5.3L Vortec LS pulled from a wrecked 2001 Chevy truck, paired to a 4L60 automatic. Builder wired the whole swap himself and had it professionally tuned for about $500 (upstream O2 sensors only), passing emissions inspection with no check engine light. Reported only a qualitative 'night and day' improvement over the original engine, no dyno numbers.

complications.detail: Builder described doing all the wiring himself as 'the hardest part' of the swap
Stock-appearing shifter retrofitted with custom internal linkage modifications for proper operation
